;Disasters and accidents
*[[List of earthquakes in 2018|Earthquakes in 2018]]
**A [[deep-focus earthquake]] of magnitude 8.2 (the strongest recorded in 2018) strikes the [[South Pacific Ocean]] near [[Fiji]].  No threat of [[tsunami]] is immediately detected. [https://katu.com/news/local/82-quake-reported-near-fiji-no-tsunami-threat-for-west-coast-hawaii (KATU)]
*[[19 August 2018 Lombok earthquake]]
**A 6.3-magnitude earthquake strikes the [[List of islands of Indonesia|Indonesian island]] of [[Lombok]], killing 14. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/19/lombok-magnitude-63-earthquake-rocks-indonesian-island (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2018 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[2018 Pacific typhoon season#Tropical Storm Rumbia|Tropical Storm Rumbia]] kills nine people in [[Anhui]] and [[Henan]] provinces, [[China]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-08/19/c_137402637.htm (Xinhua)]
*[[2018 Pacific hurricane season]]
**[[2018 Pacific hurricane season#Hurricane Lane|Hurricane Lane]] weakens to a Category 3 storm and is expected to pass south of [[Hawaii]] throughout the next few days. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/hurriance-lane-category-3-central-pacific-latest-weather-forecast-track-path-today-2018-08-19/ (CBS News)] [http://www.staradvertiser.com/2018/08/19/weather-updates/powerful-hurricane-lane-on-path-to-move-south-of-hawaii-this-week/ (''Honolulu Star-Advertiser'')]

;International relations 
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**[[Italy]] [[Italian Minister of the Interior|Interior Minister]] [[Matteo Salvini]] threatens to return 177 migrants who have been aboard an Italian coast guard ship for days to [[Libya]]. [http://amp.timeinc.net/time/5371306/italy-malta-libya-immigrants-migrants-ship (''Time'')]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War In Afghanistan]]
**[[President of Afghanistan|Afghan President]] [[Ashraf Ghani]] calls for a conditional cease-fire with [[Taliban]] insurgents for the duration of the [[Eid al-Adha]] holiday. [http://www.foxnews.com/world/2018/08/19/afghanistan-president-calls-for-taliban-cease-fire-to-mark-eid-holiday.html (Fox News)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/08/afghanistan-ghani-declares-eid-ceasefire-taliban-180819143135061.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Bolivarian diaspora]]
**Brazilians attack Venezuelan migrants at a border camp, the Brazilian military is deployed to stem the conflict. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/08/19/brazil-sends-troops-venezuela-border-residents-drive-migrants/ (''The Telegraph'')]
**[[Ecuador]], [[Peru]], [[Brazil]], [[Colombia]], and [[Chile]] tighten border controls for Venezuelan migrants. Over 7% of Venezuela’s total population has fled the nation in two years. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/19/fleeing-venezuelans-suspicion-hostility-migration-crisis-ecuador (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Colombia-Venezuela relations]]
**The Venezuelan armed forces send two attack helicopters and a brigade of 30 soldiers across the Colombia-Venezuela border. Colombia denounces the "violation of sovereignty" but takes no further action against the country. [http://www.ntn24.com/america-latina/el-informativo-ntn24/colombia/gobierno-de-colombia-denuncio-incursion-militar-desde (NTN24)]
*[[Premiership of Justin Trudeau]], [[Illegal immigration to Canada]]
**[[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] shuts down a woman who heckled him about [[Illegal immigration to Canada|illegal immigration]], telling her that “[[Racism in Canada|racism has no place]]” in [[Canada]]. [http://thehill.com/policy/international/402568-trudeau-shuts-down-heckler-racism-has-no-place-in-canada (''The Hill'')]
;Sports
*[[2018 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final]]
**In [[hurling]], [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] defeat [[Galway GAA|Galway]] in the [[2018 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final]] at [[Croke Park]] to win the [[Liam MacCarthy Cup]] for the first time since 1973. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/gaelic-games/45227782 (BBC Sport)] [http://www.skysports.com/watch/video/sports/gaa/11477012/galway-vs-limerick-hurling-final-highlights (Sky Sports)]
*[[Cincinnati Masters]]
**[[Novak Djokovic]] beats [[Roger Federer]] in [[Lindner Family Tennis Center|Cincinnati]], becoming the first player to win singles titles in all nine [[ATP World Tour Masters 1000]] tournaments in his career. [https://www.thestar.com/amp/sports/tennis/2018/08/19/novak-djokovic-beats-roger-federer-in-cincinnati-final.html (''The Star'')]
